links.outcome: AI leukocyte classification accuracy compared with 15 morphologists against a senior-expert gold standard
links.effect: AI overall accuracy 95.97% (ranked second among AI and 15 morphologists); abnormal subsets 91.38% (ranked fifth).
links.quote: The AI achieved an overall accuracy of 95.97% (ranked second) and 91.38% accuracy for the abnormal subsets (ranked fifth).

screen.reason: The study compares an AI digital morphology system (MC-100i) against 15 morphology experts on blood smears, analyzing diagnostic accuracy and error patterns, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
